end.summary:
Practised making 100 with tens numbers and using jumps on a number line.
Answered 30 + 70 and 80 + 20 correctly in some attempts.
For 65, used the incorrect partner 45 instead of 35; this was not corrected later.
Number-line jumps between 65 and 100 remained unclear; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised finding partners that make 100 and showing the difference with jumps on a number line. They used known tens pairs such as 80 and 20, and explained that the gap from 70 to 100 is 30. There was still a mix-up with 65: they chose 45 by making both digits add to 10, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use small number-line jumps to count from 65 to 100 and check that the total added is 35.
